description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1852/48, Kesbewa D/S Division - Cad. Map No. 521203 and other amendments
reasoning: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act.
